issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water Fund 62,905.88, Sewer Fund 30,759.04 (p1); Debt Service Account 8.73, W/S Ext/Rpl 30.55 (p2)
issues.issue: Almost all of the business-type 'Local Receipts: Other' is in the Water and Sewer Fund columns, so it is most likely utility charges. It was kept as 'other' under the 2026-10-23 label decision. 'Local Receipts' is a context label, so the context check should settle it from the page. The same applies to detail[30] and detail[33].

issues.on_page: Line 39 Debt Service (Governmental section) - Debt Service Account 8,625.48
issues.issue: The form prints this under Governmental disbursements. The extractor treats it as business-type because the account is funded only by Water Fund transfers (p5) and the 2017 water improvement debt is outstanding. This is defensible and matches FY2023/FY2024, but it is an assumption.

issues.on_page: line 21 Total Receipts includes line 20 transfers in 8,797.32 + 6,117.36
issues.issue: The business-type receipts total 108,618.88 includes 14,914.68 of transfers in (and disbursements 95,798.29 includes 14,914.68 of transfers out), but 'includes' is empty. Only the nonstandard 'includes_split' field records this. The figures reconcile: 93,704.20 + 14,914.68 and 80,883.61 + 14,914.68.
